title: ID0453769-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / P8 170000766] Problems with plug
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Customer reports that he has encountered problems with plug 01
several times. Charging sessions are systematically interrupted.
This plug has already been replaced, so this didn't fix the issue.
